title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][review] Allow bounded SIP and STP correction during implemented review remediation
body:
## Problem

Exact pre-PR review can find stale SIP authority or STP acceptance wording after an issue reaches `implemented`, but typed `csdlc-edit` rejects the existing semantic replacement operations in that phase. This leaves generated lifecycle truth contradictory unless it is hand-edited, which is forbidden.

## Required fix

Permit bounded typed SIP authority and STP acceptance-criteria correction during `implemented` while an active claim exists. Preserve card ownership, digest/generation/CAS checks, renderer/schema validation, audit recording, and review invalidation.

## Acceptance

- `csdlc-edit` can replace SIP authority and STP acceptance criteria during `implemented`.
- No generic field editing is enabled in implemented phase.
- Mutations remain claim-, generation-, and digest-guarded and atomically re-render cards.
- Reviewed, published, and merge-ready phases remain fail-closed.
- Focused tests, format, strict Clippy, and exact review pass.
- PR body includes `Closes #<issue>`.
